identity.name: Mutant Ape Yacht Club
identity.notes: MAYC is researched separately from BAYC. Current official Otherside documentation proves Mutant Ape avatar/runtime support through GLB character definitions, but no exhaustive downloadable MAYC VRM inventory or equivalent of the BAYC-specific Avatar File download terms has been proven.

evidence.note: Current OpenSea collection logo asset for Mutant Ape Yacht Club.

short_description.value: Yuga Labs' Ethereum companion collection to BAYC, launched in August 2021 through Mutant Serum mutations and a public mint of additional Mutant Apes.

evidence.note: Official MAYC history describes the serum mutation and public auction launch.
Official BAYC history states MAYC launched August 28, 2021.
Current official BAYC ecosystem links page exposes the shared club Discord used by BAYC/MAYC community surfaces.
Current official BAYC ecosystem links page exposes @BoredApeYC; no distinct official MAYC X account is presented there.
Yuga's current About page lists Mutant Ape Yacht Club among its collections.
Current Otherside avatar documentation includes Mutant Ape Yacht Club in supported avatar/runtime material.

ip_rights.summary: MAYC holders own the purchased Mutant Ape art and receive a worldwide, royalty-free personal license plus an unlimited worldwide commercial license to use the purchased art and create derivative works, while Yuga retains the MAYC/BAYC trademarks and other project IP.

evidence.note: Current official MAYC License sections 1A-1D define ownership, personal use, unlimited commercial use and reserved project IP.

Current Otherside documentation says relevant character meshes are downloaded at runtime from GLB definitions. This proves 3D runtime support, not an exhaustive VRM inventory or downloadable holder file set.
